title: Banda Orders Action Against Ram Raiyas and Bhujangis

blocks.text: The grievance against the Ram Raiyas and Bhujangis intensifies here because the page preserves direct abuse against the Guru and Sikh recitation. In response, Banda issues written orders to the Payal thana so that the offenders are not merely argued with but arrested, plundered, and expelled.

The page treats slander of the Satguru as a political as well as spiritual offense, turning insult into administrative action. That is why the order carries the weight of governance: contempt for the Panth now triggers intervention from the new Sikh authority.

By the end of the page, the narrative is already preparing to turn again toward Malerkotla. The controversy is handled quickly, but it shows how Banda's rule reached into local discipline as well as warfare.
